links.outcome: Whether extracted labels come with verbatim supporting evidence spans locatable in the source report
links.effect: Over 99% of final evidence spans locatable in source report; 3B model reached 47.5 auditable-F1, 7.6 points above Qwen2.5-7B one-shot and approaching Qwen2.5-72B.
links.quote: For evidence-grounded extraction, over 99% of final evidence spans are locatable in the source report, and the 3B model achieves 47.5 auditable-F1, outperforming Qwen2.5-7B one-shot prompting by 7.6 points and approaching Qwen2.5-72B.

unlisted_practices: Local (on-premise) small-model inference to keep clinical text within institutional infrastructure
Silver-label supervision with GRPO refinement for training compact extraction models

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a small, locally deployable LLM (ChestPheNoT) to extract structured labels and supporting evidence spans from radiology reports, comparing its benchmark performance across test sets without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or workflow.
